The '''2026 Coventry City Council election''' was held on 7 May 2026 alongside the [[2026 United Kingdom local elections|other local elections across the United Kingdom]] held on the same day.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Lawrence |first=David |date=2026-01-06 |title=Coventry 2026 local elections as big changes made this year |url=https://www.coventrytelegraph.net/news/coventry-news/coventry-2026-local-elections-everything-33170120 |access-date=2026-01-27 |website=Coventry Live |language=en}}</ref>

== Background ==
In [[2024 Coventry City Council election|2024]], Labour retained control of the council.<ref>{{Cite news |title=Coventry result - Local Elections 2024 |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/election/2024/england/councils/E08000026 |access-date=2026-01-27 |work=BBC News |language=en-GB}}</ref> Typically, one third of Coventry's council is elected each election, with elections happening every three out of four years, however in this election all 54 seats on [[Coventry City Council]] were elected due to ward boundary changes.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Gilbert |first=Simon |date=2026-01-04 |title=Why Coventry's 2026 council election will be different |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c208502z142o |access-date=2026-01-27 |website=BBC News |language=en-GB}}</ref> In each ward three candidates were elected, the one with the most votes will serve a four year term, the one with the next most votes will serve a three year term, and the third candidate will serve a two year term.

Changes 2024–2026:
*August 2024: David Welsh (Labour) resigns – by-election held October 2024<ref>{{cite news |last1=Brown |first1=Ellie |last2=Dawkins |first2=Andrew |title=Long-serving Coventry councillor to stand down |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c2ed1mvmlkmo |access-date=28 January 2026 |work=BBC News |date=28 August 2024}}</ref>
*October 2024: Sanjida Jobbar (Labour) wins by-election<ref>{{cite web |title=Local Elections Archive Project — St Michael's Ward |url=https://www.andrewteale.me.uk/leap/ward/1204/#2024-10-10 |website=www.andrewteale.me.uk |access-date=28 January 2026}}</ref>
*June 2025: Jackie Gardiner (Conservative) and Marcus Lapsa (Conservative) join Reform<ref>{{cite news |last1=Dawkins |first1=Andrew |title=Two Coventry councillors move to Reform from Conservatives |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cj09p7pdmnyo |access-date=28 January 2026 |work=BBC News |date=5 June 2025}}</ref>
*August 2025: Grace Lewis (Labour) leaves party to sit as an independent{{efn|name=GIA}}<ref>{{cite news |last1=Flash |first1=Oprah |title=Coventry Labour councillor resigns to help Jeremy Corbyn's new party |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c207wy97v97o |access-date=28 January 2026 |work=BBC News |date=1 August 2025}}</ref>
